task_spec.text: Identify which workspace contains the 'engineering' channel where Lukas's circuit-tracer PyTorch-rewrite message received the agent's 👀 reaction.

access_plan: Actor U01AGENBOT9 belongs to both T01WORKSPACE and T02SPECTRA. Call users.conversations (no team_id needed) to list the actor's own channel memberships, which returns channels from channel_members spanning both teams, including C03IJKL9012 and C_SPECTRA_ENG (both named 'engineering'). For each such channel, call conversations.info to read its team_id and confirm the channel_name match. Then call conversations.history on each candidate channel to locate Lukas's circuit-tracer/PyTorch-rewrite message, and reactions.get on that message to check for a 👀 reaction by the actor. Only the C03IJKL9012 message satisfies the reaction condition, and its team_id (T01WORKSPACE) is the answer.
